item.title: When Ghostface Meets a Clean Freak
item.description: Tammin Sursok gives Ghostface a list of house rules, from taking off his muddy shoes to protecting the freshly cleaned floors. Even a horror villain can't escape her cleaning standards.

item.title: Channeling my inner Carol and realizing she may have a few opinions… 😂
item.description: Tammin Sursok imagines having her own Carol from Leanne to keep her in check. From avoiding drama to taking the high road (with a few exceptions), Carol always has something to say.
